technology_name: ONE POT SYNTHESIS OF ETHYLENE GLYCOL/CARBON QUANTUM DOT (EG/C-DOT) NANOFLUID FOR HEAT TRANSFER APPLICATIONS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional industrial cooling fluids possess low thermal conductivity, limiting the heat-rejection efficiency of compact thermodynamic loops. This scalable one-pot synthesis yields stable carbon quantum dots directly dispersed inside the base fluid without aggregation.
description: A streamlined, scalable one-pot synthesis method for creating high-thermal-conductivity EG/C-DOT nanofluids by reacting ascorbic acid inside a highly alkaline ethylene glycol solvent using a copper acetate catalyst.
applications: High-efficiency industrial heat exchangers, EV battery thermal management systems, data center liquid cooling architectures, and solar thermal collectors.
